# Reflex index

## Element types
- text, note, math, shape, connector, image, frame, region, embed: built in. `read_me("<type>")` for fields and examples.
- ink, file: made by people only.

## Recipes
- check-my-work: a problem, a writing Region and a "Check my work" button.
- review-graph (Library, saved by Claude Code · reflex repo): a dependency graph with a legend.

## Embed Templates
- chart: a Vega-Lite chart whose Marks resolve to data rows.

## Guides
- code-maps, math-tutoring, grading, charts, 3d
